title: The Ledger of Saint Alder's
author: Freya Nakamura
blurb: Odile Brightwater, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
